description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Rescind of Maximum Retail Price for Rice (Order No. 78)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Consumer Affairs Authority exercising its regulatory powers under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act to rescind previous orders regarding maximum prices for rice. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of existing regulations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories.
